title: Soccer in the class survey
observableEvidence: Converts a fraction to a percent and to a decimal, and uses it to find the part of a whole.
prompt: In a school survey of 60 students, 11/20 of the students chose soccer as their favorite sport. Write 11/20 as a percent and as a decimal, then find how many students chose soccer. Type numbers only, without a % sign.
solutionRepresentation: 11/20 = 55/100, so it is 55% and 0.55. The part of the whole is 11/20 of 60 = 60 ÷ 20 × 11 = 33 students.
solutionMethod: Rename the fraction with a denominator of 100 to read the percent, divide by 100 for the decimal, then take that fraction of the whole.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Structured number fields. The percent is entered without a % sign (whole number or decimal form); the decimal accepts decimal form only. All three must be correct; no partial credit.

hintSteps.prompt: A percent is a number out of 100.
hintSteps.question: What number can you multiply 20 by to get 100?

hintSteps.prompt: Multiply the top and bottom of the fraction by that number, then read the percent. The decimal shows the same number of hundredths.
hintSteps.question: How many hundredths is the percent, written as a decimal?

hintSteps.prompt: A different example: 1/4 is 25/100, which is 25% and 0.25, and 1/4 of 80 apples is 20 apples.
hintSteps.question: Is your number of students a part of the 60 students, not the percent itself?
